+class RefinedModel:
+    def __init__(self, shape='sqrt', peak=True, penalty=0.02, tilt=False, robust=False):
+        self.shape, self.peak, self.penalty, self.tilt, self.robust = shape, peak, penalty, tilt, robust
+
+    def fit(self, d, y):
+        x, self.names = features(d)
+        self.keep = np.ones(x.shape[1], dtype=bool)
+        if self.shape != 'sqrt':
+            for e in ['V', 'Nb', 'Ti']:
+                self.keep[self.names.index(e)] = False
+                self.keep[self.names.index('sqrt_'+e)] = False
+        self.names = [n for n, b in zip(self.names, self.keep) if b]
+        x = x[:, self.keep]
+        self.scale = x.std(axis=0)
+        self.scale[self.scale < 1e-8] = 1
+        x = x/self.scale
+        alloy = d[['V','Nb','Ti']].to_numpy()
+        proc = process_values(d)
+        self.k = k = x.shape[1]
+        loss = 'soft_l1' if self.robust else 'linear'
+        init = least_squares(lambda b: x@b-y, np.linalg.lstsq(x,y,rcond=None)[0],
+                             loss='soft_l1', f_scale=20).x
+        p0, lower, upper = list(init), [-np.inf]*k, [np.inf]*k
+        if self.shape != 'sqrt':
+            p0 += [200,250,100, 0.3,0.2,0.3]
+            lower += [0,0,0, 0.02,0.02,0.02]
+            upper += [1000,1000,1000, 5,5,5]
+        self.peak_index = len(p0)
+        if self.peak:
+            p0 += [400, 0.1,0,0.7, 0.7,0.25,0.2]
+            lower += [0, -1.5,-1.5,0, 0.08,0.08,0.05]
+            upper += [1500, 1.5,1.5,2, 2,2,1.5]
+            if self.tilt:
+                p0 += [0]
+                lower += [-2]
+                upper += [2]
+
+        def residual(p):
+            pred = self._predict(x, alloy, proc, p)
+            resid = pred - y
+            if self.peak:
+                resid = np.r_[resid, np.sqrt(self.penalty)*p[self.peak_index]]
+            return resid
+
+        result = least_squares(residual, p0, bounds=(lower,upper), loss=loss, f_scale=20, max_nfev=600)
+        self.params = result.x
+        self.cost = result.cost
+        return self
+
+    def _predict(self, x, alloy, proc, p):
+        pred = x@p[:self.k]
+        if self.shape != 'sqrt':
+            amp = p[self.k:self.k+3]
+            scale = p[self.k+3:self.k+6]
+            if self.shape == 'exp':
+                pred = pred + (1-np.exp(-alloy/scale))@amp
+            elif self.shape == 'rational':
+                pred = pred + (alloy/(alloy+scale))@amp
+        if self.peak:
+            j = self.peak_index
+            z = proc - p[j+1:j+4]
+            if self.tilt:
+                z[:,1] -= p[j+7]*z[:,0]
+            bump = np.exp(-0.5*np.sum((z/p[j+4:j+7])**2, axis=1))
+            pred = pred + p[j]*bump
